scope: One bound log excerpt with every line retained; fresh short turns, not long-context/cash or task-success evidence

implementation.procedure: Exact opt-in adapter source/archive equality; independent CPU regression tests and native candidate reconstruction.
implementation.acceptance: Exact opt-in adapter source/archive equality; independent CPU regression tests and native candidate reconstruction.

reference_boundary.procedure: Independent deterministic replay of selected data and declared oracles, plus failure/budget/scope tests.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Independent deterministic replay of selected data and declared oracles, plus failure/budget/scope tests.

data_integrity.procedure: Exact original-to-redacted RPC checks; separate fresh threads, all paid calls, full usage and source/config binding.
data_integrity.acceptance: Exact original-to-redacted RPC checks; separate fresh threads, all paid calls, full usage and source/config binding.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Finite exact provider token sums; positive total-token saving including output and all calls; cache not subtracted.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Finite exact provider token sums; positive total-token saving including output and all calls; cache not subtracted.

measurement_validity.procedure: Identical model, effort, observable non-task instructions, tools and settings; no rerouting, no tools or retries; same oracle.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Identical model, effort, observable non-task instructions, tools and settings; no rerouting, no tools or retries; same oracle.

reproducibility.procedure: Pre-dispatch frozen plan, input and host verifier; distinct owner host process, exact history/controls and CPU replay.
reproducibility.acceptance: Pre-dispatch frozen plan, input and host verifier; distinct owner host process, exact history/controls and CPU replay.
